routesToMount.note: Mount under the global /api prefix already applied in app.ts

sharedTypesRequested: BrandDnaView from creativeBrandIntelligenceService — callers may pass brandDna fields from this shape
integrationOrder: Routes must be mounted AFTER adminAuthWithExceptions middleware is applied in app.ts (already global — no change needed)
No dependency on other teams' features
No migration required for MVP — uses existing ai_templates table via port abstraction
knownRisks: ai_templates table must be seeded (pnpm seed) for matching to return results — empty table returns topRecommendation: null
categoryToServiceTypes mapper in adapters.ts is a best-effort heuristic — extend when new categories are added
StaticComponentPort / StaticPatternPort / StaticTokenLibraryPort are stubs — replace with DB-backed versions when dedicated tables exist
Confidence will be low when callers omit brand DNA or industry — expected behaviour, not a bug
